name: hacknation-databricks-ops
description: PM2 process management for the uv-managed Python application

scripts.dev: uv run --locked streamlit run src/hacknation_databricks/ui.py --server.address 127.0.0.1 --server.port 8000 --browser.gatherUsageStats false
scripts.check: uv run --locked ruff check . && uv run --locked ruff format --check . && uv run --locked pytest && node --check ecosystem.config.js
